title: File:Resurgent Manas.webm
description: Manas is a National Park and animal reserve in Western Assam. In the last decades two issues have become critical and have been successfully solved: the reintroduction of endangered species like the Rhino or the Bengal Florican, and the involvement of local communities to restrict and overcome poach
note: Excerpt (15 s) of the 25-min CC BY 3.0 film 'Resurgent Manas' (Ministry of External Affairs, India, 2010, dir. Gautam Saikia); fetcher --file refuses sources over 240 s, so the Commons 480p transcode was trimmed with ffmpeg. Source has no higher transcode than 480p.
